## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO; see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] Opened against `dev`; CI passes (`go test -race ./...`, `tsc`, `npm test`, `npm run build`)
- [ ] Tests for new behaviour
- [ ] UI text in English and Turkish; light and dark theme; keyboard reachable
- [ ] New endpoint / permission / audit action / env var / metric / Kubernetes right: `CLAUDE.md` checklist and `go run ./cmd/docgen`
- [ ] User-visible change: documentation PR (EN + TR) in k8sopenconsole/k8sopenconsole.github.io
